captions.detailed: A wall-bracket box fan featuring a thick, square outer housing with rounded corners in a light grey finish. The front and back of the housing are fitted with circular, concentric wire grilles, while a dark grey rectangular motor box sits at the rear. Inside, a dark five-blade fan is mounted on a central axle, and a small black selector knob is located on the side of the housing. The housing can pan on its vertical wall joint, the fan blade rotates continuously on its central axle, and the selector knob rotates continuously on its shaft.
captions.instruction: Generate a utility wall-bracket box fan with a thick square housing, concentric wire grilles on the front and back, and a rectangular motor box. The model should include a five-blade fan that rotates continuously, a side-mounted selector knob that rotates on its shaft, and a vertical pan joint connecting the housing to its wall bracket.
captions.factory: Construct the main square housing by extruding a rounded rectangle and shelling or subtracting an inner volume. Model the front and rear wire grilles using concentric circular sweeps intersected with radial support spokes. Create the five-blade fan by arraying extruded blade profiles around a central cylindrical hub. Assemble the parts using continuous joints for the fan axle and the side selector knob, and a revolute joint for the vertical pan joint on the mounting bracket.
